name: Slow burn
summary: One long rise with no breakdown: energy is only ever added, never taken away, until the piece arrives where it was always heading.
motif: Heard first as a fragment; the full motif is withheld until the peak, where it finally plays complete.
surprise: The pedal under everything finally moves in the last third: the harmony the piece has been holding back.
ending: At or just after the peak: a held chord that rings out, not a fade back to the start.
